caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair, viewed at an angle that shows the left side and front. The chair features a curved, slightly reclined back with a rectangular top rail and a horizontal slat below. The legs are saber-shaped, curving outward both at the front and back, creating an elegant profile. The seat is dark, possibly black or very dark brown, suggesting it may be cushioned or upholstered, contrasting with the medium brown color of the wooden frame, which shows a visible wood grain pattern. The background is plain and light, providing no additional objects or scene, and the illustration is signed in the bottom right corner with the text “M. Goodman Federal Arts Project Richmond, Virginia.”
title: Side Chair
